review.scope: Independent JSON arithmetic, exact cross-variant invariant equality, process isolation and source checkout. Native Variant/type/custody predicates remain source-bound cloud-engine evidence.

independent_review.method: Independent fetch and recalculation from completed job 109147841951; static log/JSON audit, not a separate engine run.
independent_review.judgment: Reasonable to keep within the measured scope; mixed +2.572 ms is a small measured regression, not zero regression or statistical significance.

decision: Keep the bounded correction: all correctness gates passed; all four cold and warm complete-commit pairs improved. Median paired deltas are -28.8505 ms cold, +2.572 ms mixed and -48.7915 ms warm. Mixed pairs range from -1.221 to +4.476 ms (three slower, one faster) on roughly 900 ms baseline commits, so retain this small measured tradeoff rather than claim zero regression. No predeclared timing threshold, significance test, workload weighting or full-game responsiveness claim is implied.

comparison.sampling: Four alternating pairs per cold/mixed/warm mode; twenty-four fresh isolated processes. Each independent metric keeps five fresh-state samples after two warmups. No pooled/nested timing sum or timing threshold; OS caches are not flushed.
comparison.scope: Accepted226 commit/splice and journal proof learning versus current warm document-proof path; remaining port/journal methods and public raw-proof validator are shared and source-guarded. Each variant seeds its own journal implementation outside timing. Direct schema composition always has 66 trusted raw bundles with 0/51/66 normalized proofs. Complete commit uses the same real journal proof count, causing full fallback for cold/mixed and splice for warm. Exact Day7 bytes, types, proofs, journal and physical files/ordered traces with FakeFileOps; no physical disk, public preparation, gameplay or input-to-paint claim.
